forest: RandomForestRegressor, 300 trees, hyperparameters fixed at the full-sample cross-validated choice stored in results/nonlin.json (full_sample_rf_hp)
statistics: D = RMS deviation of the 5-point partial dependence from its best straight line; G = best continuous hinge (breakpoint over levels 2-4), RMS reduction in squared error; Gmax / Dmax = maximum over interest, compare, sleep

initial.generation: OLS fitted values + residuals resampled with replacement (rounded to integers and clipped to 1-5 for the rounded-and-clipped null)

ordinal.generation: ordered-logit fit (BFGS) on standardised predictors; outcomes sampled from the fitted category probabilities

retune.data: same simulated outcomes as the rounded-and-clipped initial null (resample seed 10000 + i)
retune.inner_cv: 5-fold, seed i, 100 trees, grid min_samples_leaf {1,3,5,10,20} x max_features {0.33,0.6,1.0}

size.seed: 7000000 + 100000*dgp + rep with dgp 0 = rounded-and-clipped, 1 = continuous, 2 = ordinal
size.critical_values: 95th percentiles of the saved B = 2000 nulls

power.hinge_form: 0.15/0.30/0.45 * max(interest - 3, 0) (extra rise over levels 3-5 = 2 x slope)
power.critical_values: 95th percentile of the linear scenario at the same N
